items.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
items.sub: Awesome Games Studio · Bullet Heaven, Action Roguelike, Zombies
items.desc: The Horde is coming, but you're ready to fight it! Assemble your squad, choose their upgrades, and build powerful synergies against thousands of undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break every limit in this deceptively simple but addictive bullet heaven game.

items.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
items.desc: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

items.name: Rubinite
items.desc: Rubinite is an extremely challenging boss rush action game. in a dark fairy tale world, use Ruby's crimson eyes to expose the weak points of the Bloodstained monsters, then strike and shatter them. Carve a road home through the ruined Scarlet Kingdom and face the Witch who took it all.

items.name: SHRED A BILLION
items.desc: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 999,999,999 bills left to go!

items.name: Shark Mart
items.desc: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

items.name: PC Store Together
items.desc: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.

items.desc: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

items.name: Sovereign Tower
items.desc: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

items.name: Emberward
items.sub: Refic Games · Early Access, Tower Defense, Strategy
items.desc: Build twisting mazes with tetromino blocks and deploy unique towers in this strategic roguelite tower defense adventure!

items.name: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School
items.sub: 聂宇星 · Casual, Simulation, Free To Play
items.desc: Return to Campus 2 brings back absurd open-world comedy, now with online multiplayer! Play as a super-rich heir exploring a modern city and a medieval world. Complete quests, meet NPCs, cruise around, pick fights, and cause chaos across two eras.

items.name: Arcane Abyss
items.desc: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

items.name: Iris's Idle Log
items.desc: An idle RPG for the corner of your screen. Follow Iris's long adventure, battle for equipment and resources, and grow Life Skills like Mining, Logging, Fishing, Cooking, Farming, Writing, Painting, and Commerce. Play or step away—Iris's day goes on.

items.name: NULL VECTOR
items.sub: I9 · Action, Strategy, Free To Play
items.desc: Defend a central core in a neon geometric survival tower defense. Move and aim your operator, construct fortifications, research permanent upgrades, collect enemy ability modules, face evolving bosses, unlock endless mode, or cooperate online with up to four players.

items.name: Koishi’s Fishing Journal
items.desc: A Touhou Project fan-made desktop idle fishing game starring Koishi Komeiji. Relax and fish, collect varied fish and rare merfolk, cook ordinary fish, gather precious merfolk ingredients, and sell dishes. Keep upgrading and unlocking your collection as Koishi’s fishing life unfolds on your desktop.
